_comment: Dictionary-biasing corpus. Each utterance embeds one or more Parleq-domain terms that a generic ASR model tends to mis-transcribe without vocabulary boosting. The `text` is the reference (correct spelling). The `terms` field lists which dictionary terms the utterance exercises (informational; the actual boosting vocabulary is bench/dictionary.json). Terms are chosen to be pronounceable in running speech (not spelled-out initialisms) so the fixtures resemble real dictation rather than letter-by-letter spelling.
